capabilities: assign custom icons (emoji, Lucide, text) to pinned tabs
resize pinned tab widths with an optional shrink toggle
create folder, pattern, and tag-based icon rules
set per-file icons via a frontmatter property
detect and reorder conflicting icon rules
extras: Runs entirely locally with no network requests; installable via community plugins, manual download, or BRAT.
problem: Obsidian gives pinned tabs no visual identity or width control, making it hard to tell them apart at a glance.

relations.evidence: Inspired by nicosomb shrink-pinned-tabs plugin and community discussions on tab customization

summary: Tab customizer that resizes pinned tabs and assigns them custom icons based on file names, folders, patterns, tags, or a frontmatter property.
